defects.description: Instructions say rest one arm behind the head, elbow winged out. Derived: R shoulder_abd 34.4, L shoulder_abd 24.4 (both arms at sides, neither raised). R shoulder_sagittal_flexion +16.7, L +9 (both slightly forward, neither behind head). No arm is in behind-head position. PR-v3 fixed spine sign correctly (12 to -12 for recline) but did not address arm.

Instructions say prop both feet on a nearby surface (legs extended forward, feet elevated on ottoman/stool). Derived: L/R knee 129.9 deg (deeply bent — feet tucked back near body, NOT extended forward onto surface). Hips flexed 80 deg (thighs slightly forward, OK). For feet propped forward, knees should be near-straight (~20-30 deg).

regression_risk: medium-high - 5-field change including large shoulder abduction (rightShoulder -110) and big knee straightening (130 to 25). Anatomically valid (arm-behind-head + legs-extended are common seated-recline shapes). Balance should remain OK (COM shifts forward with knee straightening but torso reclines back, compensating).
rationale: Two defects, five fields. (A) Arm behind head: rightShoulder -110 (was -12) raises right arm to ~130 deg abduction per cross-ankle-sit precedent (raw -110 produced derived 132.9 abd). rightElbow 100 (was 45) bends forearm so hand goes behind head, elbow winged out. shoulderFwdR 15 (was -5) flips sign: positive raw = negative derived = upper arm slightly BEHIND vertical (per inverted sign), positioning hand behind head rather than in front. (B) Feet propped: leftKnee/rightKnee 25 (was 130) straightens legs so lower legs extend forward onto prop surface at thigh height. Hip flexion 80 stays (thighs slightly forward, compatible with reclined sit). spine -12 already correct (PR-v3) for reclined back arch. Confidence moderate: 5-field change with renderer sign-flip on shoulderFwdR; magnitudes calibrated from cross-ankle-sit precedent but exact behind-head geometry cannot be verified without re-render.
